meta.description: Gmail new mail → Groq classify → Telegram if high or deadline. Import into n8n Cloud, attach Gmail + Groq creds, set TELEGRAM_* env vars.
meta.rateLimitNote: Caps ~6 alerts/hour via workflow static data.

nodes.name: Telegram Alert

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, text: 'Kuro: ' + ($json.alert_line || $json.subject || 'Urgent mail'), disable_web_page_preview: true }) }}

nodes.notes: Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in n8n variables. Bot must have received /start from you.
